newsitem.title: USA: NOTICE OF SALE - Stockbridge CSD, N.Y.
newsitem.headline: NOTICE OF SALE - Stockbridge CSD, N.Y.

text.p: SEALED PROPOSALS will be received and considered by the President of the Board of Education of Stockbridge Central School District, Madison County, New York, at the Office of Fleet Securities, 14 Wall Street, New, York, New York, until 1:00 P.M., Prevailing Time, on

at which time and place the bids will be opened, for the purchase IN FEDERAL FUNDS at not less than par and accrued interest of $5,674,473 School District (Serial) Bonds, 1997 (the Bonds'').The Bonds are payable in annual installments which, together with interest thereon, are expected to provide for substantially level or declining annual debt service on the Bonds, as defined and described in paragraph d of Section 21.00 of the New York Local Finance Law, with option to prior redemption as described below, on June 15 in each year as follows:
The Bonds will be dated April 15, 1997 and will bear interest payable semi-annually on June 15 and December 15 of each year commencing December 15, 1997.

The Bonds maturing on or before June 15, 2005 are not subject to redemption prior to maturity. The Bonds maturing on or after June 15, 2006 are redeemable at the option of the School District on or after June 15, 2005, as a whole or in part in inverse order of maturity (selected by lot within each maturity) on any interest payable date, at redemption prices expressed as a percentage of par, plus accrued interest to the redemption date, as follows: June 15, 2005 and December 15, 2005 - 102%; June 15, 2006 and December 15, 2006 - 101%; and June 15, 2007 and thereafter - 100%.

The Bonds will be initially issued in registered form in the name of Cede & Co., as nominee of The Depository Trust Company, New York, New York, which will act as securities depository for the Bonds. The Bonds will bear interest at the rate or rates per annum in multiples of one-eighth or one-hundredth of one per centum (ascending rates with a maximum difference between the highest and lowest interest

rate bid should not exceed 1.50% and only one rate maturity) specified by the successful bidder. The Bonds will be awarded to the bidder offering to purchase the Bonds at such rate or rates of interest as will produce the lowest net interest cost in accordance with the terms set forth in the full Notice of Sale. A good faith deposit in the amount of $113,490 should accompany each bid.

THE SCHOOL DISTRICT RESERVES THE RIGHT TO CHANGE THE TIME AND/OR DATE FOR THE OPENING OF BIDS. NOTICE OF ANY SUCH CHANGE SHALL BE PROVIDED NOT LESS THAN 24 HOURS PRIOR TO THE TIME SET FORTH ABOVE FOR THE OPENING OF BIDS BY MEANS OF A SUPPLEMENTAL NOTICE OF SALE TO BE TRANSMITTED OVER THE MUNIFACTS WIRE.
The Bonds will be treated as qualified tax exempt obligations'' pursuant to Section 265(b)(3) of the Internal Revenue Code of 1986, as amended.
The purchaser will be furnish the Bonds and the approving legal opinion of Hodgson, Russ, Andrews, Woods & Goodyear, LLP, Albany, New York, on or about May 7, 1997.
Requests for copies of the Notice of Sale herein

summarized and the Official Statement relating to the Bonds and such other information as the State Comptroller may prescribe by rule or order may be directed to Fiscal Advisors &Marketing, Inc., Cicero, Professional Building, Suite 112, Cicero, New York 13039; Phone (315) 699-7912; Fax (315) 699-8833.
